title: Music Tree, 1 dollar

specs.Decoration: laser frosting, digital printing, crystal inserts

descriptionPlain: Description Already Plato has noticed that music „gives soul to the universe, wings to the mind, flight to the imagination, and charm and gaiety to life and to everything.” The silver „Music Tree” coin is a symbol of the power of music and its influence on human life. It is music that accompanies us at important events and commemorates the most solemn moments. Like nature, it lasts unchanged despite the passage of time. Where words fail, music speaks Original gift for the music enthusiast Symbolism based on art and nature Silver of the purest quality Great attention to detail
